raw_segments.text: The effect of this dispatch was instantaneous.
The polished gentleman disappeared to give place to the bank robber.
His photograph, which was hung with those of the rest of the members at the reform club,
was minutely examined, and it betrayed, feature by feature, the description of the robber
which had been provided to the police.
The mysterious habits of Filia's fog were recalled, his solitary ways, his sudden departure.
And it seemed clear that, in undertaking a tour around the world on the pretext of
a wager, he had had no other end in view than to elude the detectives and throw them off
